findings.title: 'Kit' charges without itemization
findings.explanation_en: A kit billed as one line (₹900) with no contents is disallowed as 'any kit with no details mentioned'. Most of its contents are usually payable consumables.

explanations.en: A kit billed as one line (₹900) with no contents is disallowed as 'any kit with no details mentioned'. Most of its contents are usually payable consumables.

findings.fix: Before filing, go to hospital billing desk and say: 'Please give me itemized breakup of Dressing kit Rs.900 on hospital letterhead with stamp and signature, showing each item name, quantity and rate.' Ensure gauze, bandage, antiseptic etc are listed separately. Attach this breakup to the final bill.
